text: てに　もった　ホネで　あいてを　なぐって　こうげきする。

structure.jp: てに　もった　ホネで
structure.en: with a bone held in its hand

structure.jp: あいてを　なぐって

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: てに　もった　ホネ
patterns.explanation: A short phrase ending in a verb, put right before a thing, tells you which thing is meant. てに　もった　ホネ = 'a bone held in its hand'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here shows the tool used to do something. ホネで = 'with a bone'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: なぐって　こうげきする
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions, and here the first is the way the second is done. なぐって　こうげきする = 'attacks by hitting'.
